# EdgeForms — form backend on the Cloudflare edge

RegisterMySite EdgeForms is a Formspree-style inbox that never leaves Cloudflare. Sign up, generate a form with Workers AI, and POST to your destination email.

### EdgeForms — form backend on the Cloudflare edge

https://forms.registermysite.com
